people.name: Louis Étienne Joseph Marie de La Vallée-Poussin
people.field: Indologist and scholar of Buddhist Studies

relations.subject: Louis Étienne Joseph Marie de La Vallée-Poussin
relations.evidence: He studied at the University of Liège from 1884 to 1888, receiving his doctorate at the age of nineteen.

relations.subject: Louis Étienne Joseph Marie de La Vallée-Poussin
relations.evidence: He studied Sanskrit, Pali, and Avestan under Charles de Harlez and Philippe Colinet from 1888 to 1890 at the University of Louvain, receiving a docteur en langues orientales in July 1891.

relations.evidence: He continued his study of Avestan and the Zoroastrian Gathas under Hendrik Kern at Leiden University, where he also took up the study of Chinese and Tibetan.

relations.subject: Louis Étienne Joseph Marie de La Vallée-Poussin
relations.evidence: In 1893, he attained a professorship at the University of Ghent teaching comparative grammar of Greek and Latin, a position which he held until his retirement in 1929.
